For rent

Rentals

Two homes are open for rent in Sharingwood right now — a furnished downstairs unit, and a whole multi-level house.

$1,595 /mo · deposit $1,595

Unit 1B — 22003 E Lost Lake Rd

1 large bedroom + smaller room1 bath1,200 sq ftAvailable Nov 16, 2026

Renovated lower unit of a modern home. Fully furnished — dishware, linens, sound system — with hardwood floors, large windows, patio and a 3-person sauna.

  • Private entrance, kitchen & bathroom; upstairs occupied by a couple
  • Bosch washer & dryer in unit; dishwasher, oven, fridge
  • Parking for 2 cars (tandem) · fast internet · Alexa-connected sound
  • Utilities: tenant pays 30% by usage, ~$175/mo average · HOA $59/mo
  • 12-month standard WA lease · no smoking · no cats · dogs only with upstairs tenants’ agreement (+ $350 cleaning fee)
  • Schools: Maltby Elem 3.1 mi · Hidden River Middle 3.3 mi · Monroe High 3.5 mi

What the community is like

Sharingwood is one of Washington’s oldest cohousing communities: 29 privately owned homes and 40 units, shared amenities, and neighbors who actually know each other.
